quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may be crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. You may see several of these signs along a curve.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They warn you about hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for traffic coming from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets. It means you cannot go in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about danger ahead. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue straight or exit the freeway from your lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue straight through.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leads off the freeway. If you stay in this lane, you will exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway, or you must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light or yield to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can go if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic can only go in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic can only go in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign means traffic flows only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What is the main danger when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not work because one side of your car is higher.
A tire could be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply to get back on the road. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It means drivers must obey the law shown. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm up and swings it upward, it means riders should go faster.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road enters from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns of a T intersection where you may need to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop or slow down for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge ahead at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride near traffic here.

questions.question: What is the correct order of a traffic light from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green on the bottom of a vertical traffic light. When horizontal, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show turns or stops. When the left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the operator plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a railroad crossing where the tracks are at a steep slope. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When an operator's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show turns or stops. When the left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the operator plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: People are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Slow down and watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What is the order of traffic light colors from bottom to top?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights from bottom to top are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with another road is ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass traffic or for going straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has several sharp curves ahead. Slow down and be ready to steer.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond sign warns drivers that a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two one-way roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane on your side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you about a steep downhill section ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Stop signs are eight-sided. At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Check for pedestrians and other traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may be wet and slippery. Drive carefully and reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road in this area. Watch for cyclists.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for residential areas.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for highway exits. It tells you the maximum speed to safely exit the highway.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When you bend your left arm at the elbow and point it upward, you are signaling a right turn or lane change to the right. Use hand signals instead of or in addition to your turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you there is a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a sharp turn coming. Reduce your speed before the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that a lane is ending. Get ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at this exact speed.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Only certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are only for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger, all riders should line up in a single-file formation.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bike repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: When group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with their palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Only yield to traffic on your right.
Only yield to traffic on your left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The highest safe speed in good weather and road conditions.
The highest safe speed in all weather and road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed in good weather and road conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest speed allowed on that road. You may need to drive slower than this limit in bad weather or poor conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop and check for traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find a different route.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown, which is 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you plan to drive.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to show no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let other traffic go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let any other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging in from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will be entering from the right side.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down when you see this sign. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways before you cross the intersection.
You must stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is closed to traffic.

questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange with black markings. They warn drivers of dangerous conditions in work zones. This sign tells you that construction or maintenance work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers are on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on an upcoming hill.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves right, then curves left.
The road curves left, then curves right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then curves left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn of hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes very slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are forbidden.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a complete stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming. Be alert for other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only goes one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic only moves in one direction on this street. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. Move your vehicle to the left lane safely.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the driver is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: This triangle sign is a Yield sign. Slow down to check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that an intersection is coming. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that traffic is joining from the right. Be ready to let other vehicles merge safely.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always watch for children and be ready to stop. Let all pedestrians cross safely before you drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: This sign warns you that ahead is:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Proceed only when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a merging traffic sign. You should:

options.text: Always stay at your present speed.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When on a multi-lane road, make room for vehicles entering the freeway. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign warns you to slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Yield to other drivers and pedestrians. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, following riders should slow down.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This regulatory sign has black markings on a white background. You must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you to keep right. It warns you about a hazard ahead and tells you which direction to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show turns or stops when mechanical signals are not used. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing upward means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead makes a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
